title: On-device LLM (OS model)
summary: Text LLM built into the OS: Apple Intelligence (iOS 26+) or Gemini Nano (Android). No download for the app, works offline, multi-turn via sessionId.
limits: No token streaming: the whole answer arrives at once.
Android caps output at 256 tokens: ask for short answers.
Only on supported devices: check availability() / ensureReady() and show a fallback.
